hier.note: pipeline/hier.py, one quarter ahead on a rolling origin: median absolute revenue-growth error of the model (cond: given the parent's actual growth; uncond: with the parent forecast too) vs the naive forecast (growth stays what it was); cover80: the share of actuals inside the 80% interval; beats_naive: entities where uncond < naive.

polymarket_prices.note: Polymarket's implied price (ladder median) frozen before each market's date and scored when it resolved (app/consensus.py).

verdict: Combined forecast, 3 months: mean absolute error 15.7% vs 15.7% for 'no change' (not better); 80% range coverage 75% over 24,365 forecasts from 15 quarters — the quarters, not the forecasts, are the independent sample.

No paired comparison with the Rotation forecasts yet (the forecast ledger was not available or does not overlap): the Rotation forecast stays as "Our model" and the combined forecast is published beside it with its own score.
notes: Walk-forward: every forecast uses only data known 60 days after its quarter ended, and a model fitted on outcomes already known then. Analysts' targets enter only from the consensus module's daily snapshots (about a year so far); Polymarket prices have no history yet, so their weight is not learned — they are scored in the valuation ledger as months pass.
The DCF features at past dates use today's cost of capital, debt and cash (small look-ahead), stated here.
